clips.title: The story
paras: Ambermill is a fortified human settlement in central Silverpine Forest, situated just southwest of Lordamere Lake. Once a quiet lumber village, it is now occupied by surviving wizards and apprentices of Dalaran. Their presence represents a dangerous outpost of human resistance on the southern borders of the Forsaken realm.

Before the Third War, Ambermill was a quiet lumber town of little importance. In the chaotic aftermath of Lordaeron's fall, the surviving wizards of the Kirin Tor moved in and fortified the settlement. Dalaran spellscribes, conjurors, and apprentices now patrol its buildings and stables, using Ambermill as a forward redoubt against the undead.
